name: Bloodstorm Berserker
summary: Frenzy Attacks hit every enemy twice, stack Bleed and lifesteal. Lunge pops Rupture on the whole group.

name: Everburn Pyromancer
summary: Burn every enemy with Burn that never fades, then Detonate the whole group.

name: Barrage Marksman
summary: Volley hits every enemy every turn with no cooldown. Steady Aim makes Aimed Shot a sure crit.

name: Skewer Dragoon
summary: Skewer spreads Bleed to every enemy, then Impale Sunders them all and they Rupture.

name: Bloodletter Assassin
summary: Twin Cut spreads Bleed to every enemy, Mark for Death makes them all Rupture.

name: Mocking Jester
summary: Mockery hits every enemy and Taunts them. Taunted enemies also get Vulnerable.
